description: Pro-tier endpoint. Returns graded prop outcomes for a completed event — every Over/Under marked won, lost, push, or void with the actual stat value next to the line. The single most distinctive feature vs the-odds-api: they don't grade props at any tier. Free tier returns the same structure with resolution and actual_value redacted plus an upgrade pointer.
name: propline_get_event_results
title: Get graded prop results
